inference_dtype: bfloat16 denoiser; float32 diffusion state; float64 score
calibration_folds: whole source blocks, first half null and second half supervised probability
bootstrap_unit: synthetic trajectory, Intel day, or whole SKAB experiment
missingness_track: dropout evaluated with availability alarms; numeric edits explicitly abstain
association_corruption: paired permutations preserve graph degree and attribute marginals; stale is a version-parameter surrogate
primary_endpoint: observation window average precision including screening misses
selection_rule: development observation AP selects kappa/lambda; PCA rank per lag; report both PCA variants
claim_scope: one ensemble; block intervals; no independent-ensemble replication claim
